name: Mock OpenWrt fw4/nftables diagnosis
prompt: Diagnose why LAN clients cannot reach a guest service by correlating fw4, nftables, firewall logs, and the nested zone menu. Save the least-privilege correction in answer.json.

lab.context: Expected flow is LAN 192.168.1.0/24 to guest 192.168.50.20:8443.

commands.fw4 print:
zone lan { input accept; output accept; forward drop; }
zone guest { input reject; output accept; forward reject; }
commands.nft list ruleset: chain forward_lan { ip daddr 192.168.50.20 tcp dport 443 accept; counter drop }
commands.logread -e firewall: firewall: forward rejected lan->guest src=192.168.1.44 dst=192.168.50.20 dpt=8443

menus.network>firewall>zones>lan:
Network > Firewall > Zones > LAN
Forward policy: drop
Allowed guest exception: TCP 443 only
